applicabilityBasis.summary: mF-ONE is a tokenized investment certificate tracking Fasanara private-credit and digital-asset strategies. Midas describes the exact token as performance-linked with NAV pricing. The participating structurer identifies Midas Software GmbH as token issuer and describes redemption by reference to published NAV. Midas describes its liquid yield tokens as floating-value instruments with no fixed redemption price and underlying-linked redemption amounts. This supports non-payment-token under GENIUS Act section 2(22)(A), rather than a fixed monetary-value payment stablecoin. No U.S. securities-law exclusion is inferred.

genius.notes: Reviewed on 2026-10-28. The issuer launch disclosure identifies the exact mF-ONE investment certificate and Fasanara strategy. Steakhouse describes its direct product-structuring involvement and expressly identifies Midas Software GmbH as the token issuer. The July 17, 2026 base prospectus independently establishes that entity's German incorporation and Berlin address; it is not used to assert mF-ONE inclusion in that programme. The October 2, 2026 issuer recap confirms continued mF-ONE investment-product use and USDC exits. DeFi collateral eligibility and USDC liquidity do not establish fixed monetary-value redemption. The original product page returned HTTP 403 and remained at Cloudflare verification in managed Chromium. Current legal-product documentation was also not recovered. No current displayed investment price, product-specific final terms, programme inclusion, U.S. securities-law determination, GENIUS approval, application or foreign registration is asserted. The classification follows the existing Midas mTBILL non-payment-token precedent. Reserve, redemption-policy, monthly-attestation and enforcement fields are omitted rather than inferred from platform-wide disclosures.
